sections.title: Treatments
sections.sql: select product, batch, acvm_number, treated_on, head, dose_ml, operator, whp_days, whp_clear from treatment_register where mob = (select name from mobs where id = $1) order by treated_on
sections.note: The product label and your vet's directions govern treatment. Demo withholding periods are fictional.

name: asd-worksheet
title: ASD preparation worksheet
for_each: select id, name from sale_plans where status = 'planned'

sections.title: Readiness
sections.sql: select name, mob, sale_date, head, destination, whp_clear, decision from sale_readiness where id = $1
sections.note: A working sheet for filling in the ASD. It is not the ASD and it does not record anything in NAIT.

sections.title: Treatments still within withholding on the sale date
sections.sql: select t.product, t.treated_on, t.whp_days, t.whp_clear from treatment_register t join sale_plans sp on sp.id = $1 join mobs m on m.id = sp.mob_id where t.mob = m.name and (t.whp_clear is null or t.whp_clear > sp.sale_date)

sections.title: Destination
sections.sql: select destination, destination_nait, asd_ref, status from sale_plans where id = $1

name: audit-pack
title: Farm assurance and farm plan working pack

sections.title: The farm
sections.sql: select name, nait_number, region, ffp_status, ffp_due, nzfap_audit_due, nait_declared_on from farms where id = $1

sections.title: Findings
sections.sql: select rule, record, issue, source from compliance_findings where $1::uuid is not null order by rule, record
sections.note: Missing or late records in this database. Not an audit result.

sections.title: Stock on hand
sections.sql: select name, species, paddock, head, history_verified, whp_clear from mob_summary where farm_id = $1 order by name

sections.title: Nitrogen this season
sections.sql: select n.paddock, n.land_use, n.n_kg_ha, n.cap_kg_ha, n.decision from nitrogen_board n join paddocks p on p.id = n.id where p.farm_id = $1 order by n.n_kg_ha desc

sections.title: Farm plan actions
sections.sql: select name, risk, due, status, evidence from ffp_actions where farm_id = $1 order by due

sections.title: Hazards
sections.sql: select name, location, controls, owner, reviewed_on from hazards where farm_id = $1 order by name
